title: The Spear Hero's Splendid Day Off
paragraphs: "Oh, Kitamura."
When I go to the castle garden, Kou comes running over to me. It’s unusual to run into him here.
"Oh? It’s Kou, isn’t it? What’s up?"
“Well, you see—Elmero’s working, but he said it’s okay if Kou doesn’t come, so I’m minding the place. We promised to play again around snack time.”

Lately, Kou’s been getting along really well with Zou. Zou’s quite the caretaker, isn’t he? By the way, Kou’s also pursuing a career as an Idol. Even though he’s a boy, he’s pretty popular. He dances gracefully in the back with everyone else. His singing seems to be on point lately, too.
“What kind of games do you play?”
“Well, Elmero leads us in choir practice so we can all sing together happily. Even though his voice is on the lower side, it carries really well—it’s amazing!”

Hmm… Come to think of it, I’ve noticed lately that the Filolial-sama’s singing has improved even without me supervising them. There’s a Filolial-sama who sings with a slightly operatic style. I remember Kou used to sing that way, too. I wonder if Zou taught them that?
“So—Kitamura. I’m bored waiting to play with Elmero—isn’t there anything fun to do?”
“That’s true…”

It’s my day off, too, and I was thinking about helping Yuki-chan and the others, but maybe she was being considerate—she told me to just do whatever I wanted today. So, there’s no doubt I’m really bored. At times like this, playing with Filolial-sama, who’s bored just like Kou, is probably the best option.
But since Kou and I are finally alone together, it’d be nice to play a game that’s a little different from usual.
“Well then, I’m going to play with Kou. Just the two of us guys—let’s play a game we can’t play with Yuki-chan and the others.”
“Whoa! What is it? What are we going to play?”
Kou’s eyes are sparkling as he listens to the new game I’m about to teach him.
“That game is, quite simply… picking up girls!”

This is something I used to enjoy back in the day—a very fun way to enjoy meeting new people. Come to think of it, I haven’t done it in a while, but it’d be nice to give it a try around here. Back in the day, I used to do some pretty gross stuff with pigs, but now’s the time to take on a new challenge.
“What’s a ‘pick-up artist’?”
“To do that, we’ll have to head out.”
“Got it! Let’s go to Kitamura!”
“Of course!”
I climbed onto Kou’s back—who had transformed into Filolial-sama—and set out from Siltvelt Castle. And so… while guiding Kou, we wandered aimlessly until we spotted our target.
“Gua Gua”
“Guaa”
“Gua”
We found them after leaving the town below Siltvelt Castle and passing along a road a little way from civilization. They were wild Filolial-sama.
“There they are!”
“Oh, it’s the Filolial-sama! Are we going to invite them, too?”
“That’s right. Picking them up and having fun together is what ‘picking up’ is all about. If you’re up for it, let’s go ahead and recruit them right now.”

Come to think of it, we might be able to increase our ranks with new faces without having to buy eggs or Filolial-sama from the monster merchant. Since wild Filolial-sama are a very close-knit group, it might be quite difficult to persuade them, but not trying to recruit them would be a mistake. This way, Father will surely forgive me.
“Alright then, Kou, I’ll show you how it’s done first.”
“Got it!”
I climbed down from Kou and quietly approached the Filolial-sama, being careful not to startle them, while slowly taking out some jerky and fruit.
“Filolial-sama, Filolial-sama, please hear me out.”
“Gua?”
The wild Filolials noticed me and began to show interest in the dried meat and fruit. Since these items are quite expensive, they should be delighted.
“I’d like to give you these as a gift.”

I placed the dried meat and fruit in front of the wild Filolial-sama and stepped back a little. The Filolial-sama, intrigued by the scent, snorted as they approached, sniffed the offerings, and began pecking at them.
“Gua!”
“Gua-gua!”

The wild Filolial-samas happily began eating the dried meat and fruit I had offered them. Ah, what a blessed joy. After confirming that the Filolial-samas’ wariness had eased slightly as they ate, I approached them, one step at a time.
“I’m glad you’re enjoying it. Since we’re here, why don’t we take a little stroll around here for a while? And then we’ll have a fun meal together.”
“Gua?”
The wild Filolial-sama tilted their little heads. This feeling of cultural exchange is a very fresh and enjoyable experience. My goal is to gradually earn their trust so I can pet them.

Actually, recruiting them as new Filolial-samas might be a good idea this time. If I take care of them, there’s a high chance they’ll end up with a build similar to Filo-tan’s. While that’s a good thing, as a new Idol, I think I’d like a bit more variety. After all, Rivals have analyzed that Father doesn’t view children as romantic prospects, so to gain a deeper understanding, we might need a Filolial-sama who looks more like a Big Sister.
Chick from the first world is a perfect example. She was a capable Filolial-sama who served as Filo-tan’s right-hand woman.

There’s the idea of having Father raise a new Filolial-sama, but Sakura-chan might get jealous. In fact, when Father was raising a new Filolial-sama, Filo-tan looked a bit envious. There wasn’t any fighting or anything, but for Filo-tan’s sake, I can’t very well go out of my way to do something like that.
“Gua!”

Filolial-sama replied cheerfully, as if she’d already agreed to the walk. She’s following right behind me. It’s quite heartwarming. So, I’ll take a short stroll and enjoy some quality time with Filolial-sama and the others.
“Now, please wait here for a moment.”
“Gua!”
I told the wild Filolial-samas that and returned to Kou, who was standing a short distance away.
“First, you invite them like this. What do you think? This is how grown men play.”
“So this is how a grown man plays—I don’t really get it, but I want to try it too, Kou.”
Kou doesn’t seem to fully grasp the fun of it, but he appears willing to give it a shot. I have high hopes for his growth as a young boy.
“Well then… go talk to Filolial-sama over there.”
I point to a Filolial-sama standing a little ways away from the ones I’d spoken to—one who’s yawning boredly, and another resting by the water.
“Got it!”

Kou takes the dried meat from me and, with a “puff,” transforms into Filolial-sama King and toddles over. Ah, Kou is taking a little nibble of the jerky on the way over. I can tell just by watching his back.
“Hey—my name’s Kou—nice to meet you—um—can I tell you a story?”
“Gwa!?”
“Guaaaaah!”
“Guh!?”
The moment Kou transformed into the Filolial King, the wild Filolial-samas stood up and bowed their heads in unison. Kou offered the dried meat to the wild Filolial-samas, just as I had demonstrated.
“Here, this is a present!”
The wild Filolial-sama approached the offered dried meat with nervous expressions and ate it timidly. Kou, you’ve made a bit of a mistake there. They’re on their guard. You have to be friendlier!
“I’m so happy you accepted it, Kou—since you’re here anyway, why not come with me?”
“Gua!”
“Gua gua!”
“Guaaaaaaaah!”

At Kou’s words, the herd of wild Filolial-samas is following right behind him. There are more of them than the Filolial-sama I invited. Or rather, the Filolial-sama I invited have gotten mixed in with the herd and are tagging along now.
“Is this how it’s supposed to be?”
“Y-yes, I suppose so.”

This is… could it be that everyone has gone over to Kou’s side? I, Motoyasu, never imagined it would turn out like this. I never would have guessed Kou had such playboy tendencies… His future is going to be terrifying.
“Anyway, the pickup was a success! Well then, let’s spend some fun time playing with the Filolial-sama for a while!”
“Ooh!”
“Gwaaaaah!”
“Guaaaah!”

And so, with me riding on Kou’s back, we spent a delightful time in the meadow near the highway—joyfully racing with the wild Filolial-samas, hunting monsters to gather food, and repairing the carts and other belongings owned by the Filolial-samas.

A little past noon, with the wild Filolial-sama’s nerves now settled, I was petting them and preening their feathers. What a blissful time. While preening Sakura-chan and Yuki-chan’s feathers is nice, this isn’t half bad either.

So, I got everyone excited by telling the Filolial-sama stories about sparkling treasures and clothes. After all, in the first world, they really enjoyed listening to these kinds of topics. We even got excited discussing how to make things like glass shards and broken sword fragments look beautiful—not just pointlessly expensive gems. So, I polished up a piece of glass I’d found as a drop and showed it to them.
“Guaaaaah…”
Everyone’s completely captivated by the sparkling glass.
“This is a present, too.”
“Gua!”
When I handed the polished glass shard to a wild Filolial-sama, they were delighted.
“Um… I don’t really get what Kitamura’s saying, but he’s saying, ‘Thank you for the delicious food, for fixing my cart, and for the beautiful things!’”
Kou is acting as our interpreter. At some point, Kou started chatting away in Filolial-sama’s language.
“That’s wonderful to hear. Now then, Kou, I’d like you to explain something while we’re at it.”
“What?”
“It’s a rare chance to meet them. I want you to tell them, ‘Let’s cherish this encounter and aim to become Idols together with me, won’t you?’”
“Hmm? Got it. Kue-kue.”
Kou starts chatting with the wild Filolial-sama.
“Gua?”
“Gua-guaa…”
“Guaa”
Kou, nodding repeatedly, turns his face toward me.

“‘Huh? An Idol who sings and dances?　That sounds fun!” This one said, and the next one said, “But isn’t this the Spear Hero we heard about?” So when Kou replied, “Yeah,” she said, “The Queen said even if the Spear Hero invites me, I’m not allowed to go with him.”
“What…?”
Is this a decree from Her Majesty Filolial-sama? This… isn’t Her Majesty trying to cause me trouble; rather, it’s out of concern for her valued subjects.

I, too, recall having to persuade troublesome parents back in the day when I was socializing with pigs. Looking back now, I think they should’ve just shipped the pigs off, but I suppose they were wary of handing over pigs they’d raised with such care to some unknown dealer without a second thought. I can certainly understand the feeling that it would be a shame to just hand over someone like Yuki-chan to some unknown nobody, Filolial-sama. Of course, that wouldn’t apply if the Filolial-samas themselves sincerely wanted to go with that person.

But the Big Filolial-sama has a sense of responsibility that’s proportional to its massive size. It probably won’t let you recruit a wild Filolial-sama so easily. Now is the time to show your sincerity.
“Then please show me through to the Great Filolial-sama. Let’s talk another time. Please tell them I said, ‘I’d really love to meet them.’”
If it comes down to it, I wouldn’t even mind helping the Great Filolial-sama make their Idol debut.
“Kue-kue.”
Kou acts as our interpreter.
“Gua!”
The wild Filolial-sama nodded in response. After that, a slow and pleasant time passed for a while.
“Kitamura, isn’t it about time for Elmero to arrive?”
Kou looked at the sun and pointed out that the time was drawing near.
“Oh? Is it that late already?　Well then, let’s call it a day and head back.”
“Got it~”
And so, we said goodbye to the wild Filolial-sama and headed back to the castle.
“Kou, what did you think? This is what hitting on people is all about—it’s a game where you enjoy making new connections.”
“Hmm? I don’t really get it!　But, somehow, everyone was rubbing up against me!”
“You’re quite the ladies’ man!”
“I’m a ladies’ man!”
HAHAHA, maybe romance is still a bit too early for Kou. By the way, I remember that in the first world, Kou fell in love with a monster modeled after Big Sister.
So, here’s the thing. A few days after I asked the wild Filolial-sama to contact the Great Filolial-sama, about five wild Filolial-samas showed up near the castle.
“Gua-gua!”
They’re chirping at us in a friendly way. Seeing them, Father said,
“What are they saying?”
“Well, let’s see—”
“Gua-gua!”
“Gua-gua!”
“Gua-gua!”
“It sounds just like how Sakura-chan pronounces ‘Idol’…”
“Yeah, that’s what they’re saying.”
“Does that mean they’re candidates who want to become Idols?”
Oh, we’ve successfully scouted them! However, Filolial-sama didn’t come. He’s such a busy person, so he probably couldn’t spare the time.
“Fitoria says she’d like us to cut her some slack on this.”
“Cut her some slack… Well, it seems Motoyasu-kun asked Ms. Fitoria to talk it over… A sacrifice…”
“Hmm…”

Éclair nodded in agreement. A sacrifice… I have absolutely no idea what kind of situation would require Filolial-sama to become a sacrifice. And so, the wild Filolial-sama has joined our Philoreal Idol Group.
